after_network_id.description: compare two networks: before_snapshot_id is read in network_id, after_snapshot_id in this network; the saved query runs on both and rows are diffed here by key

key.description: with after_network_id: the result columns that identify a row (default: the whole row, so only rows on one side are found)

ignore.description: with after_network_id: columns dropped from both sides before comparing (names or ids expected to differ between networks)
